items.html: Now, he wished to bring out the externality of the inner MA and BON in him as well, outward. Then all the discernments of the inner SAG, hidden inside the inner MA and BON, rose, and the inner MA and BON rose with them. And then these MA and BON are their MAN for the Taamim of SAG themselves, which are not clothed inside MA and BON; and they stand in the relation of AVI to YESHSUT. For just as, for the need of the conception of ZON, the upper AVI couple and YESHSUT are included with them, so here (11) the Taamim of SAG couple with the whole AB, and all the more so do the Nekudot, tagin, and letters of SAG join with them and are subordinate to them; therefore they do not come up by a name, like the aforementioned YESHSUT. And then they beget the discernment of BON of externality, and their garment, outward. Thus the female is now born first.
